summary.headline: The cart cache container valkey-cart stopped at 04:10:44 (exit code 0, unhealthy), so add-to-cart, view-cart and checkout requests now hang for 15-30 s. Before that, payment could not be reached (DNS lookup for payment failed) until its container came back at 04:09:14. Checkout has thrown no errors since then.

affected_services.impact: Container exited and is unhealthy, so the cart backing store is gone.
Cart requests through frontend-proxy hang and fail. Slowest traces are user_view_cart at 15627.6 ms and user_checkout_single at 30914.3 ms.
user_add_to_cart requests take about 15.9 s and the frontend-proxy egress spans fail. The proxy->frontend hop averages 4733.1 ms on the client side.
Errors on the 'router frontend egress' span. load-generator->frontend-proxy averages 12307.7 ms.

Error rate was 0.3333 over 3m. All 6 failed traces came from PaymentService/Charge failing with a DNS lookup error for payment. There have been no checkout errors in the last 2m, but checkout traffic is down (rps 0.024 vs 0.057).
Could not be reached (DNS 'server misbehaving') until the container started at 04:09:14. Traffic is now 0.012 rps vs a 0.057 baseline, because fewer checkouts get far enough to call it.

root_causes.cause: The valkey-cart container exited (exit code 0, not OOM-killed, unhealthy) at 04:10:44 and is not running. cart depends on it, so cart operations hang until they time out. Requests through frontend-proxy for add-to-cart, view-cart and checkout fail after 15-30 s. This is the problem that is still active.

proposed_action.reason: valkey-cart exited and is unhealthy. Cart needs it to serve all cart and checkout flows. Restarting the container brings the dependency back. No action is proposed for payment, because it is running and healthy again.
proposed_action.risk_assessment: Low. valkey-cart only holds cart sessions, and it is already down, so restarting it cannot make the outage worse. Carts stored in memory before the stop may be lost.
proposed_action.expected_outcome: valkey-cart is running and healthy. Cart and frontend-proxy errors stop, and add-to-cart and view-cart latency drops from about 15 s back to normal. Checkout, payment, shipping and email traffic return to baseline (payment about 0.057 rps).

prevention: Set restart: unless-stopped/on-failure on valkey-cart and payment, and alert when their health check fails, so a stopped container is caught right away.
Give cart short connect and command timeouts to valkey so requests fail fast instead of hanging for 15-30 s.
Find out who or what stopped valkey-cart and payment with exit code 0 (a manual docker stop or tooling) and restrict that access.
open_questions: Why did valkey-cart exit with code 0, which looks like a deliberate stop rather than a crash? Check the Docker daemon events.
The earlier payment restart is logged by our tooling as a dry run ('nothing sent'), yet the container started at that same moment (04:09:14). What actually restarted payment?
After valkey-cart is restored, confirm that payment rps and checkout error rate return to baseline.
The cart logs had no valkey-related lines. Check whether cart is logging connection errors at all.
